subject: Post-call: Integration sprint milestones & owner commitments (MAP draft)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Carter <emily@healthcore.com>, Marcus Holt <mholt@healthcore.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 17 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Integration sprint milestones & owner commitments (MAP draft)

Hi Emily / Marcus — thanks again for the call this morning. Attaching a first-pass MAP focused on the integration build work we discussed (SDK + streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs). Key points / proposed milestones below. Please treat this as a draft — happy to iterate.

Quick recap of commitments from today:
- Redwood will provide an SDK integration package (Node + Python) and a streaming example for real-time triage flows. Owner: Dev Patel (see timeline below).
- HealthCore needs to provide a sample message schema and the first 3 canonical prompts we want to preserve for QA. Owner: Emily.
- Targeted pilot: integrate SDK into triage service, validate end-to-end with structured output schema and tool-calls by 2026-06-18 (proposed).

Draft milestones (high level):
1) Kickoff & alignment (this week) — owners: Pr / Emily — complete by 2026-05-21
2) SDK integration + sample app (Redwood) — owner: Dev Patel — 2 weeks (2026-05-22 to 2026-06-04)
3) Streaming example and KV/caching config (Redwood) — owner: Dev Patel — 2026-06-05 to 2026-06-11
4) Tool-calling adapter + structured outputs mapping (joint) — owners: Jasmine (RW) / Emily (HC) — 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-15
5) End-to-end pilot & QA (joint) — 2026-06-16 to 2026-06-18 — target close date for pilot phase

Dependencies we flagged: API keys / test access, sample schema, a small dataset for quality validation, and confirmation of expected latency SLOs.

Attachments: MAP_HealthCore_v0.2.pdf (MAP draft), integration-specs-HealthCore.xlsx (lightweight tech spec).

Next steps / asks:
- Emily: confirm the sample schema owner and whether the June pilot window works for you.
- Marcus: confirm whether HealthCore security needs a separate SOC2 evidence request — we can loop in Security if yes.
- Dev: confirm SDK delivery schedule below and note any blockers.

I can update the MAP and push v0.3 once we have your feedback (Emily). If acceptable, I'll schedule a focused 30-min technical kickoff for Tuesday.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_HealthCore_v0.2.pdf (PDF, 760KB)]
[Attachment: integration-specs-HealthCore.xlsx (XLSX, 220KB)]

From: Emily Carter <emily@healthcore.com>

Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Integration sprint milestones & owner commitments (MAP draft)

Thanks, Priyom — this is helpful. I shared the doc with our engineering lead and we have two small asks:  

1) Can we push the pilot validation window one week later (target end 2026-06-25) to accommodate our regression window and a security review?
2) For the tool-calling adapter, we'd like HealthCore to own the mapping of our internal actions -> tool calls (we can provide a first-pass spreadsheet). Jasmine, can your team take point on the adapter integration and we will take responsibility for the action mapping?

Other notes: we'll provide the sample message schema and the three canonical prompts by 2026-05-21 EOD. Marcus — we'll need confirmation on the security evidence ask; if we need SOC2 docs please confirm and Priyom can route.

If you can reflect these two changes in v0.3, we can approve and book the technical kickoff for next Wednesday (2026-05-26).

Best,
Emily Carter
Director, Platform Engineering — HealthCore

Priyom / Jasmine — quick tech clarifications before kickoff:  
- For streaming, do we need to support bi-directional websockets (push from RW + push from HC), or will a server->client streaming model be sufficient for the triage pilot?
- Schema: is HealthCore providing a flattened JSON schema or nested objects? The adapter effort depends on that.
- Do we have a non-prod endpoint for the pilot or should I wire the sample app to Redwood's staging cluster?

Emily — if you can paste the schema sample inline or attach the spreadsheet (per your note) that will unblock the SDK adapter work. If not, I can prototype an adapter for both flattened and nested payloads but would prefer to avoid duplicate work.

Thanks — I'll wait for Emily's schema before freezing the SDK deliverable.

- Dev

Thanks all — quick alignment from the integration squad:  

1) Streaming model: for the pilot, server->client streaming will be sufficient (we'll provide a lightweight websocket client/consumer sample). No bi-directional real-time routing required for MVP. (Owner: Dev)
2) Schema handling: we can support both flattened and nested, but HealthCore's provided mapping will determine which path we harden first. Recommend HealthCore provide the flattened canonical schema if you can — that reduces adapter work. (Owner: Emily for mapping; Jasmine to validate)
3) Non-prod endpoints: Redwood will provide a staging cluster URL and short-lived API keys by 2026-05-24. (Owner: Jasmine)
4) Tool calls: Jasmine will deliver the adapter skeleton and test harness by 2026-06-08. Emily / HealthCore to provide action mapping by 2026-05-21.

I've attached a terse sprint plan and owner matrix to this thread (I pushed it to the shared drive and updated MAP_v0.3). I'll be on the kickoff on 2026-05-26 and will bring the adapter PoC.

Next meeting: Technical kickoff — Wed 2026-05-26 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=next-step-kickoff

Jasmine Liu
Integration Lead, Redwood Inference
